constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (batch_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (cluster_id) REFERENCES news_cluster(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (source_summary_id) REFERENCES ai_summary(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (ai_target_count >= 0 AND ai_attempted_count >= 0 AND ai_success_count >= 0 AND ai_fallback_count >= 0 AND ai_failed_count >= 0 AND ai_recovered_count >= 0)
CHECK (attempt_count >= 0 AND max_attempts > 0 AND attempt_count <= max_attempts)
CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at)
CHECK (idempotency_key IS NULL OR length(btrim(idempotency_key)) >= 1 AND length(btrim(idempotency_key)) <= 200)
FOREIGN KEY (page_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (source_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (source_page_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (batch_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (batch_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (actual_index_source_date IS NULL OR actual_index_source_date <= expected_session_date)
FOREIGN KEY (batch_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (cluster_id) REFERENCES news_cluster(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (page_market_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page_market(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (processed_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_processed(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (news_window_start_at IS NULL OR news_window_end_at IS NULL OR news_window_start_at <= news_window_end_at)
CHECK (actual_index_source_date IS NULL OR expected_session_date IS NULL OR actual_index_source_date <= expected_session_date)
FOREIGN KEY (page_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (cluster_id) REFERENCES news_cluster(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (page_market_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page_market(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (representative_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_processed(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK (source_date IS NULL OR expected_session_date IS NULL OR source_date <= expected_session_date)
FOREIGN KEY (market_index_daily_id) REFERENCES market_index_daily(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (page_market_id) REFERENCES market_daily_page_market(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (keyword_id) REFERENCES news_search_keyword(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (raw_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_raw(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (processed_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_processed(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (raw_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_raw(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (id, representative_article_id) REFERENCES news_cluster_article(cluster_id, processed_article_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (cluster_id) REFERENCES news_cluster(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (processed_article_id) REFERENCES news_article_processed(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (keyword_id) REFERENCES news_search_keyword(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (news_collection_run_id) REFERENCES news_collection_run(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK (total_keyword_count >= 0 AND completed_keyword_count >= 0 AND completed_keyword_count <= total_keyword_count AND fetched_count >= 0 AND matched_count >= 0 AND inserted_count >= 0)
FOREIGN KEY (batch_job_id) REFERENCES batch_job(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

functions.definition: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_updated_at() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN NEW.updated_at = now(); RETURN NEW; END; $function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_batch_job_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON batch_job FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_news_article_processed_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON news_article_processed FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_news_cluster_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON news_cluster FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
